statement: The W9f MP-only control uses the identical scheduled atomic stimulus, records sustained successful commits with zero errors, and shows changing mapping-view gyro during a 150-second native Dolphin arm. Observed MP frame counts/rates are separate from the decoded UI oracle. Native and combined post-mode-05 A400F0=55 are zero. This is a bounded MP-only positive control, not a passthrough or physical/rate acceptance.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revisions unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. W9f stimulus rerun; generic binding is test/dev only under virtualgamepad #258. No physical, radio, game, calibrated cadence, latency or challenge evidence.
